results.title: SQA Higher Maths Specification (X847 76) - Save My Exams
excerpts:
The Higher Mathematics course equips candidates with the mathematical knowledge and reasoning skills essential for progression in mathematics and related fields. It builds on prior learning to develop a deeper understanding of algebra, calculus, trigonometry, geometry, and statistics.
The course focuses on critical thinking, modelling real-life contexts, and problem-solving, preparing learners for advanced study or practical application in science, technology, engineering, and finance. It promotes precision, logical analysis, and the ability to communicate complex mathematical ideas effectively.
* Use vectors in 2D and 3D including scalar products and unit vectors.
* Determine collinearity, internal division, and angles between vectors.
Calculus skills
* Differentiate polynomials, trig functions, and composite functions.
* Investigate functions using gradients, stationary points, and sketch graphs.
* 55 marks ; 1 hour 15 minutes
* Short-answer and extended-response format.
* Tests application of numerical, algebraic, geometric, trigonometric, calculus, and reasoning skills without a calculator.
* Emphasises core understanding and process fluency.
Question Paper 2
* 65 marks ; 1 hour 30 minutes
* Short-answer and extended-response format.
* Calculator allowed, supporting deeper application and reasoning.
* Includes more complex problems requiring multi-step solutions.
Distribution of marks (approximate)
* Algebra: 30–45%
* Geometry: 15–35%
* Calculus: 15–40%
* Trigonometry: 10–25%
Question Paper Features
* Semi-structured papers with separate question and answer booklets.
